meta_description:
LIVE EVENT AT THE DOLBY THEATRE IN LOS ANGELES THIS THURSDAY OCTOBER 8th.

As part of the launch of my new book Protocols: An Operating Manual for the Human Body, I’ll be hosting a live event. 

There I will discuss things not covered directly in the book as well as answer audience (your!) questions. 

Also, thanks to @drinkag1 everyone who attends will get a hard cover copy of Protocols, included in the ticket price (no extra charge). 

I hope to see you there!

And thank you for your interest in science!

#protocolsbook #hubermanlablive - @hubermanlab on October 6, 2026
